_comment: Duration-balanced reliability sharding hints (MoonLadderStudios/MoonMind#4367). Per-file estimated pytest seconds used ONLY as an optimization hint for longest-processing-time shard assignment. New, renamed, or stale entries never change selection: unknown files receive default_weight_seconds and every tests/integration/reliability/test_*.py file is assigned to exactly one shard. Refresh guidance: replace estimates with the per-case durations from recent pytest-backend-reliability-shard-N-durations.json snapshots (tools/ci/write_backend_matrix_summary.py output); never gate on exact counts, file freshness, or filenames.
